title: Gentleness reveals an unsteady custom
meaning: Considerate shared action in support of meaning can accompany shock when a familiar picture of a tradition proves poorly founded.
text: In this pair’s Energy Field, Strength in the physical position concerns handling a powerful impulse without forceful pressure. The Hierophant in energy motivates the preservation of a recognised meaning, custom or shared promise. The Tower in emotions adds the sharp experience of a certainty breaking down. Even a considerate discussion about an important occasion can therefore feel emotionally acute when your picture of a shared custom turns out to rest on an assumption that was never checked in words.

For example, you discuss an annual visit to a place associated with shared memories. Instead of the familiar argument about dates, you listen carefully and discover that one person has long attended from duty, while the other considered the visit a mutual pleasure. **We preserved the custom while understanding differently what we actually shared within it.** Gentle conversation does not remove the shock of losing the earlier picture of agreement.

A difficulty intensifies if preserving the meaning becomes a demand to restore that picture immediately. Gentleness then becomes a way of overlooking the difference just revealed. Another possibility is to conclude that a mistaken assumption devalues everything you experienced. The Tower confirms neither that conclusion nor any necessary benefit from the discovery. The Hierophant as motivation does not make an identical attitude to every tradition a condition for the union itself to exist.
